shortDescription: Fluence Energy NASDAQ:FLNC plummeted 18.8% post-market Wednesday after issuing downside guidance for FY 2026 revenue of $2.4B, compared to prior guidance of $2.9B-$3.1B and below the $2.96B FactSet consensus estimate.The company also guided for a full-year adjusted EBITDA loss of ~$200M, compared t…

children: for FY 2026 revenue of $2.4B, compared to prior guidance of $2.9B-$3.1B and below the $2.96B FactSet consensus estimate.
The company also guided for a full-year adjusted EBITDA loss of ~$200M, compared to its previous outlook for a ~$10M loss, pointing to continuing supply chain issues affecting U.S. production.
"Demand for our products has remained strong both domestically and internationally, and our international supply chain has continued to work well," Fluence

President and CEO Julian Nebreda said. "However, we continue to experience delays in the ramp-up of our contract manufacturing facility in Houston, which is the primary reason we are now lowering our fiscal year 2026 financial guidance."
AES Corp. executive Bernerd Da Santos as the company's new Executive VP and COO.

title: Fluence Energy plunges after cutting full-year guidance on U.S. supply chain issues
